tools: Sheet Metal Table and Flat View
outOfScope.why: a manufacturing discipline with its own vocabulary; no JSCAD kernel support and nothing in a first-year CS course reaches for it
all require a B-rep kernel with face topology. JSCAD solids are polygon soup with no addressable faces, so these cannot be built, not merely descoped
curve-driven modelling presumes sweep/loft along a path; extrudeHelical exists in the bundle but a helix with no sweep to ride it is a toy
structural steel workflow; needs a profile library and a cut list, both outside a browser sandbox
these presume multiple documents, an assembly stage, or FeatureScript. The sandbox is one Part Studio with no document tree
each needs face or edge selection on a B-rep. Same wall as surface modelling: whyCannotRound() in lib/model-types.ts already documents this limit honestly for fillet, and it applies here too
Thicken and Enclose act on surfaces we do not have; Curve Pattern needs a curve we do not have
no extrudeAlongPath in the vendored bundle; extrudePath exists but is unexposed and untested. Reconsider if a lesson needs it
